newsitem.title: USA: Oil giants Texaco, Shell to team up in U.S.
newsitem.headline: Oil giants Texaco, Shell to team up in U.S.

text.p: Two Western oil giants, Texaco and Shell Oil Co, said on Monday they were teaming up in the U.S. market.

The companies were commenting on a report in the Wall Street Journal that they were discussing a possible merger of their U.S. downstream operations with Star Enterprise, a joint venture between Texaco and Saudi Aramco, to form the world's largest oil retailer with assets worth $10 billion.
The announcementds by the two companies made no mention of a possible link with the Saudi oil giant.
"Shell Oil Company confirms it is discussing with Texaco the potential for joint arrangements involving U.S. downstream operations," the company said.

Texaco said the goal of the discussions was to creeate a more efficient operation maximising the strength of the both companies, including their brands, to create a revitilised downstream busines in the United Styates. It said the companies will spend the next few months trying to develop an alliance to benefit stockholders of bith companies.
